notes:
fix: make download page styles global so JS-injected cards render correctly

Astro scoped CSS doesn't apply to innerHTML-injected elements. Changed
style block to is:global so the latest-card and release-card classes
work on dynamically rendered content from the GitHub API.

feat: restyle download page cards to match tools card design system

Latest release card: smaller padding, hover lift. Release history cards:
dark border, 3px shadow, green hover with color transitions — matching
the tool-card pattern from /tools.

feat: polish download page — clean version display, justify layout, strip commit prefixes

Split version tag into display version + build number, justify meta row
with version/badge left and date right, strip chore:/fix:/feat: prefixes
from release notes to show human-readable text.
